leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, wnba, ncaaf (college football), ncaab (college basketball) or soccer.

date.title: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for the current slate (this week's NFL games, today's NBA games).

days.title: Number of days
days.description: How many days to read, starting at the date (or today).

includeCompleted.title: Include finished games
includeCompleted.description: Off: only upcoming and live games. On: also games already played, with their final splits.

onlySharpSignals.title: Only games with a sharp-money signal
onlySharpSignals.description: Return only games where at least one side's share of money beats its share of bets by the gap below.

sharpGapPct.title: Sharp-money gap (points)
sharpGapPct.description: A side is flagged when % of money minus % of bets is at least this many points.
